It's a new company that has started up this year. They offer senior cardholders a discount on the job that you are quoted for. I used the guide provided by this site in relation to questions to ask the installer & this company was quite prepared to answer the questions & if the sales rep was unsure he rang the manager to make sure that he had the facts right. Every thing that the quoted to be supplied was installed as quoted.  Most companies in Canberra were quoting a 6 to 8 week wait before they could install. With Aussie Solar Hut the whole process took just over a month from installation to the local authority connecting the smart meter (it took the local authority nearly the month to connect the smart meter, the solar panels were installed in 2 days)
